comment: Hand-curated code adjudications. Each entry is a palika CBS code attested by a government directory but NOT doubly-attested (the verified tier needs postal-2025 + CBS harvest to agree), so it carries the singleSource tier with cbsCodeVerified=false. Consumed by tool/merge/resolve_code_tiers.dart (Pass A2), which reserves these codes before re-deriving the rest - that is what makes a full pipeline run preserve adjudicated codes instead of stripping them. Edit by hand only, with a documented source for every entry; the resolver and apply_npl_codes.dart hard-fail on any conflict with the dataset. Duplicates, non-PDDPP codes and unconsumed entries all fail the run.
